root_cause_analysis.symptom: Image fetching todo appears before day presentation in review.py (line 9), causing orchestrator to attempt fetching before user sees the day
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Commit 94bca5f added Step 14a/4a image fetching but placed it OUTSIDE the INNER loop, before user confirmation. Todo scripts were created to match this incorrect order.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 94bca5f - feat: Add progressive image fetching to plan and review commands
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Feature added image fetching per day to avoid waiting until final HTML generation, but didn't consider nested loop workflow where user may iterate multiple times on same day
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Fetching images before user confirms wastes time if user requests changes (images fetched, then day modified, then images need re-fetch). Correct pattern: confirm perfect → fetch once → advance to next day.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Introduced 2026-02-13, affects all /plan and /review executions since then

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 94bca5f - feat: Add progressive image fetching to plan and review commands
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Commit 94bca5f added Step 14a/3a image fetching but placed it OUTSIDE the INNER loop, before user confirmation. This caused images to be fetched on every day presentation iteration, wasting time if user requested changes (fetch → modify → re-fetch pattern).
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Moved image fetching INSIDE the INNER loop as a substep of Option 1 processing ('This day is perfect'). Now images fetch ONCE per confirmed day, AFTER user confirms perfect but BEFORE exiting loop to next day. Pattern: present day → user confirms → fetch images → set day_confirmed_perfect=true → exit loop → next day.
